params.prompt:
Create a finished 2D editorial illustration for an adult Russian logistics educational game. The supplied reference establishes ONLY drawing style, color palette, line quality, warm human character and level of detail. Create a DIFFERENT LOCATION: a modern logistics warehouse interior, not a port. Do not copy any cranes, water or boats from reference. Match its beautiful contemporary hand-drawn reportage character: refined dark navy contours, white/cool-blue backgrounds, cobalt structural accents, warm orange gift focal point, muted sage and ochre, purposeful realistic little details. Clean precise color shapes, no sepia/papergrain/retro, not generic corporate clip art and not a crude SVG diagram. Absolutely no 3D render, isometric view, toy/plastic/voxel look or photorealism.

Landscape 16:9 full scene; a genuinely flat TOP-DOWN architectural floor-plan illustration, roof removed, with artist-drawn objects, real floor markings and lots of character. Building floor rectangle entirely contained. Incoming receiving apron and large doorway on LEFT; shipping/dispatch doorway and outbound apron on RIGHT. Two distinct doors with completely open wide aisles between them. Three groups of warehouse shelving between left and right, two rows with wide central aisle and an outbound aisle along right edge. Top-down drawing, no angled wall extrusion. Use charming well-observed packing details: wooden pallets, different sizes of cardboard cartons with small pictograms of real contents, wrapped rolls, strapped containers, an open receiving cart. No piles blocking access. Large simple rack letters: А and Б in racks nearest RIGHT dispatch, Л and Н in MIDDLE racks, Ф in far-left racks. ONLY these single Cyrillic letters on rack end labels and optional restrained floor labels 'ПРИЁМКА' at left and 'ОТГРУЗКА' at right; no other lettering, no fake microtext. Alphabet organization must actually match those positions.

ONE clearly visible orange gift carton with white camera pictogram is waiting at the left receiving apron beside a manual pallet jack. It must be distinguishable from ordinary brown cargo. Leave one clean staging slot at RIGHT dispatch for a later gift-placement result, and a visible address scanner station there. Two warehouse workers in blue workwear, high-vis orange vests and safety helmets, one in receiving aisle with clipboard, one at scanner station near dispatch; natural overhead silhouettes, not emoji dots. One compact autonomous cobalt forklift with coherent forks, wheels and sensor, working in a clear aisle; one small four-rotor stocktaking drone scanning shelf labels. These are subtle technology details, not the main subject. A little office/service nook at bottom edge with locker and shelving. A few fire safety fixtures and protective yellow bollards at doors. Restrained sunlight patches, readable floor lines; complete navigable coherent layout.

The point is to understand where a gift is placed relative to receiving and dispatch, not to sort every package. Aim for the delight and craft of a premium illustrated interactive magazine: detailed enough to explore, quiet enough to read instantly. Large legible cargo groups, open negative spaces, no oblique perspective tricks. No UI, no choice numbers, no arrows, no decorative charts, no logos/watermarks. Single coherent illustration, full scene contained.
